question: What is described within the earthly principle in this section?
premises: The earthly principle is treated as surrounded by all coverings.
It is taken as a central reference point in the exposition.
The text now turns to the arrangement of worlds within it.
inference: The discussion now begins the cosmological account of worlds located in the earthly principle.
plain_english: That principle, standing amid all and covered by all the enveloping layers, is now described in terms of the arrangement of worlds within the earthly principle.
